basics.name: Yibo Zhou
basics.label: Ph.D. in Artificial Intelligence | Computer Vision and Trustworthy Machine Learning Researcher
basics.summary: I received my Ph.D. in Artificial Intelligence from the School of Computer Science and Engineering at Beihang University. My research focuses on computer vision and trustworthy machine learning, with particular interests in pedestrian attribute recognition, balanced multi-label learning, out-of-distribution detection, spurious correlation analysis, and robust representation learning. My research has been published in leading computer vision and machine learning venues, including IEEE TPAMI, IJCV, ICML, IJCAI, and CVPR.

work.summary: Worked in the 101 Laboratory and the Imaging Algorithm Development Department in Shenzhen, China, conducting research and development in artificial intelligence, computer vision, and intelligent imaging algorithms.
